description: This file defines a PhotosHandler class for managing photo retrieval and encoding from device storage, including permission checks, querying media store, image scaling, and JPEG encoding under size constraints.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for fetching latest photos, including limit, maxWidth, and quality.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class representing the encoded photo data including format, base64 string, dimensions, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission check and fetching latest photos.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing PhotosDataSource, handling media store queries, image decoding, scaling, and JPEG encoding.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class managing photo retrieval, permission validation, request parsing, and response formatting.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Handles the request to fetch latest photos, checks permissions, parses request, and returns encoded photos as JSON.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a PhotosLatestRequest object with default values and bounds.

methods.name: forTesting
methods.description: Factory method for creating a PhotosHandler instance with a custom data source for testing.
